usageDashboard.claudeOauthQuotaToggleTitle: Query official quota with Claude Code credentials
usageDashboard.claudeOauthQuotaToggleDescription: Reads Claude Code's login stored in the macOS keychain to fetch exact usage windows from Anthropic. Off by default; you can revoke it here at any time.
usageDashboard.claudeOauthConsentMessage:
Enabling this lets LLM Usage Bar read the login that Claude Code stores in the macOS keychain, and use it to query Anthropic's official quota endpoint.

It reads nothing else. The credential is sent only to Anthropic's own API as the request's authorization header, never to any third party, and it is not stored or logged by this app. You can turn this off here at any time. macOS may ask you to confirm access when the quota is refreshed.
usageDashboard.claudeOauthConsentCheckbox: I understand that Claude Code's keychain login will be read to query the official quota.
usageDashboard.claudeOauthConsentRequired: Official Claude quota needs access to Claude Code's credentials. Enable it in the Claude provider settings.
usageDashboard.claudeOauthKeychainDenied: Access to the Claude Code credential was denied in the system dialog. Try again later.
usageDashboard.claudeOauthKeychainNotFound: No Claude Code login was found in the system keychain. Sign in with Claude Code first.
usageDashboard.claudeOauthKeychainTimeout: The system authorization dialog was not answered in time. Refresh again and allow access when macOS asks.
